name: King crab
definition: Red or golden king crab (Paralithodes, Lithodes) sold as legs, clusters or split legs.
notes: Alaskan King Crab shop: King Crab collection, Red King Crab Legs sizes

name: Snow crab
definition: Snow crab (Chionoecetes) sold as legs, clusters or claws.
notes: Alaskan King Crab shop Snow Crab collection; Cameron's Alaskan Snow Crab Legs

name: Dungeness crab
definition: Dungeness crab (Metacarcinus magister) sold whole, as clusters or legs.
notes: Alaskan King Crab shop Dungeness Crab collection; Colossal Dungeness Crab Legs

name: Blue crab
definition: Atlantic blue crab (Callinectes sapidus) sold live, steamed, as soft-shell crabs or as picked meat.
notes: Shrimp Net Blue crab: live, cleaned, soft shell; Cameron's Blue Crabs category

name: Stone crab
notes: Alaskan King Crab shop Crab Variety filter Stone Crab; Florida Stone Crab Claws

name: Lobster tail
definition: Lobster tail sold frozen as a separate pack, usually Maine or warm-water; whole lobster is Lobster.
notes: shoplobster.com Lobster Tails page with Maine tail sizes; live lobster has a separate page there
